cbinsights_unicorns.zh: CB Insights 独角兽全名单

pwc_unicorns100.zh: 普华永道全球独角兽 100 强
pwc_unicorns100.coverage_zh: 2022–2025 年报告只公布汇总，不列完整 100 家；这里只收录报告正文点名的公司。
pwc_unicorns100.coverage_en: The 2022–2025 reports publish totals, not the full 100; only companies named in the text are included.
